topic: Neural Network Learning: The Intuition of Backpropagation

sections.title: The Architecture: Guessing and Checking
lecture_lines: Neural networks are interconnected nodes transforming inputs.
The loss function measures the network's prediction error.
A high loss means the prediction is wrong.

sections.title: The Mechanism: Credit Assignment Problem
lecture_lines: Each node has a weight representing importance.
Errors require identifying which weights caused the mistake.
Backpropagation identifies those responsible weights backward.

sections.title: The Core: Intuitive Backpropagation (The Chain Rule)
lecture_lines: Think of the network as connected gears.
The chain rule propagates error signals backward.
Error flows like water through a pipe.
Weights adjust themselves to reduce total error.
Backpropagation efficiently calculates these weight updates.

sections.title: The Update: Gradient Descent
lecture_lines: After calculating blame, we update weights.
We perform this step thousands of times.
This minimizes the network's error gradually.

sections.title: Conclusion: From Noise to Wisdom
lecture_lines: Learning is a cycle of prediction and correction.
Predict via forward pass, correct via backpropagation.
Repeated steps turn random guesses into wisdom.
